source_snapshot.title: Ministry of Interior postpones vehicle licensing limit for residents pending further review
source_snapshot.text: ABU DHABI, 9th November, 2026 (WAM) -- In line with its commitment to listening to public feedback and considering the needs of different segments of society, the Ministry of Interior has announced that it will postpone the limit on the number of vehicles residents may license under Article 89 of the new Implementing Regulations of the Traffic Law, pending the completion of a review and approval of the appropriate regulatory requirements.The review will consider the rights of vehicle owners, the needs of families and investors, and how vehicles are used, including classic, rare and luxury vehicles.The Ministry of Interior emphasised that public feedback and suggestions are central to improving legislation and enhancing quality of life, while protecting rights and taking different interests into account.

source_verification.reason: All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

The postponement is pending the completion of a review and approval of appropriate regulatory requirements.
The review will consider the rights of vehicle owners, the needs of families and investors, and how vehicles are used, including classic, rare and luxury vehicles.

evidence_passages.text: Ministry of Interior postpones vehicle licensing limit for residents pending further review

ABU DHABI, 9th November, 2026 (WAM) -- In line with its commitment to listening to public feedback and considering the needs of different segments of society, the Ministry of Interior has announced that it will postpone the limit on the number of vehicles residents may license under Article 89 of the new Implementing Regulations of the Traffic Law, pending the completion of a review and approval of the appropriate regulatory requirements.The review will consider the rights of vehicle owners, the needs of families and investors, and how vehicles are used, including classic, rare and luxury vehicles.The Ministry of Interior emphasised that public feedback and suggestions are central to improving legislation and enhancing quality of life, while protecting rights and taking different interests into account.

summary_ru: 🚗 Министерство внутренних дел ОАЭ отложило ограничение на количество автомобилей Министерство внутренних дел объявило о переносе введения лимита на количество транспортных средств, которые жители могут зарегистрировать, до завершения дополнительного обзора и утверждения нормативных требований. Обзор учтёт права владельцев, потребности семей и инвесторов, а также особенности использования автомобилей, включая классические и роскошные модели.
